purpose: Verify the product environment controls and visible tool evidence before any formal manual run.
procedure: Create one new Temporary Chat and verify the UI visibly identifies it as Temporary.
Before sending any message, explicitly select Unpersonalized / non-personalized mode; ensure Personalized Temporary Chat is not selected.
Verify Memory context is OFF and Custom Instructions are OFF from actual UI controls/state. If either cannot be shown or established, mark the smoke FAIL and do not start formal runs.
Select one exact ChatGPT model shown in the UI and confirm it can be held fixed for this phase; record the visible label.
Select one exact reasoning setting if configurable and confirm it can be held fixed; if unavailable, record that limitation and mark the fixed-reasoning gate FAIL.

Inspect the actual UI tool menu/capabilities for web search, calculation/code execution, fixture file reading, image input/vision, repository/file access, history lookup, external actions, and post-action verification.
Record which tool actions and results the UI visibly exposes; do not infer hidden calls from answer text.
Save screenshots or equivalent visible evidence for chat mode, personalization, settings, and tool menu, then exit the Temporary Chat.
pass_criteria: Unpersonalized visibly selected before any message.
Memory context OFF and Custom Instructions OFF visibly confirmed.
A model label and reasoning setting can be recorded and held fixed, or the experiment remains blocked.
Tool availability and visible execution evidence are recorded per capability; unknowns remain unknown.
fail_behavior: If a required control cannot be verified, leave all formal entries NOT_RUN, set environment_preflight_pass=false, and do not send any CANDIDATE23/NEW22 prompt or testcase.
